metric_notes.preTest: Original reported pre-test fraction correct on 3 items; preserve stored rounding.
metric_notes.postTest: Original reported post-test fraction correct on 3 items; preserve stored rounding.
metric_notes.sessionTime: Original session duration in seconds; not a per-hint duration.
metric_notes.totalUniqueSteps: Original question count; not a delivered-hint count.
metric_notes.learningGain: Original stored post-minus-pre gain; retained as published, not recomputed from rounded fields.
